audit: Draft to audit to final. Removed repeated announcements, staged conclusions, heavy contrasts and redundant emphasis. No new facts, experiences, numbers or citations; prose only.

edits: 状態を共通化して問題が起きたという過去の体験は確認できませんでした。この記事では、取得した設定と、確認待ちを追加する場合の判断を扱います。
状態の共通化で問題が起きたという記録は見つからなかったため、取得した設定を使い、確認待ちを追加するならどう分類するかを考えます。

files.semantic_review: Three project lists, five groups, distinct IDs, SQN-30 started and document-only evidence retained; local classification is not Plane analytics; additions are proposals.

edits: The evidence did not establish a past incident caused by making their states uniform. This article covers the configuration that was retrieved and a proposal for representing work awaiting verification.
I found no record of a past incident caused by uniform states, so the article uses the retrieved configuration to examine how a verification state could be classified.
A different reviewer does not by itself require another state.
Changing the reviewer alone need not add another state.
files.semantic_review: All sections and tables retain Japanese meaning; sampled projects are not a workspace-wide survey; classification experiment and proposed policy remain distinct.

edits: Moduleの名前だけを検証対象の証拠にしない、という話です。
Module名だけでは、検証した配布物を特定できません。
この時点で完成したリリース表を作ると、配布物の欄を推測で埋めることになります。

files.semantic_review: Both module lists empty, fixed Git version fields versus unqueried remote artifacts, proposed record with nulls and not_run preserved.

edits: Membership, however, does not establish that someone verified the artifact for that version. Membership describes planned scope; a verification result describes an actual tested target.
Module membership identifies planned scope. To establish which artifact was tested, it needs a separate verification result.
Writing a completed release report at this stage would require guessing artifact fields.
The release report cannot be marked complete while its artifact fields remain unverified.
files.semantic_review: Full translation retains remote version caveat, hypothetical rebuild and deferral, all identifiers and source links; no live build or Module mutation claimed.

edits: 特に停止位置が具体的です。「実装してください」だけでは、完成の意味が開発環境の確認なのか、本番で利用できることなのか決まりません。この本文はそこを明示しています。
この本文は、開発環境で止めると明記しています。「実装してください」だけでは、開発環境の確認と本番での利用開始のどちらを求めているか決まりません。
この分け方なら、次の担当者に渡すのは「もう一度全部確認する作業」でも「終わったことにする指示」でもなく、既存の根拠と、まだ答えのない受け入れ条件です。
次の担当者には、既存の根拠と、まだ答えのない受け入れ条件を渡します。確認済みの範囲を保ちながら、残りの作業を選ぶためです。
files.semantic_review: Acceptance versus evidence, no repository reference in retrieved ticket, fixed document history and mobile unchecked, explicit stop point retained. No app rerun or ticket write.

edits: The stopping point is particularly specific. "Implement this" alone does not establish whether completion means verification in development or availability in production. This description makes that boundary explicit.
The description explicitly stops the work in development. "Implement this" alone would leave it unclear whether completion means development verification or production availability.
This gives the next person existing evidence and acceptance criteria that still lack an answer, without requiring every completed check to be repeated or treating unfinished work as complete.
The handoff contains existing evidence and acceptance criteria that still lack an answer. The next person can use those records to select the remaining work.
files.semantic_review: All Japanese sections and criterion/evidence rows retained, proposal not special Codex parser format, document observation not newly executed success.

edits: この二つの読み取りは、「Cancelledにある」と「アーカイブへ移っている」が同じ意味でないことを示しています。
読み取り結果では、Cancelledの作業があってもアーカイブ済みの一覧は空でした。
アーカイブ先に履歴があることと、将来それを見つけられることは別に確かめます。

edits: Together, these reads show that being in Cancelled and being archived are different conditions.

edits: The finding is that successful parsing and repeatable persistence are separate properties.
Successful parsing does not establish that repeated persistence produces the same state.
